# Seventh Sense Software

> Seventh Sense Software is building developer tools that help businesses use AI agents safely; the first product is in development. We also take on software engineering work for finance. We don't hold customer funds or provide financial, legal or investment advice. 7s.software

## Internal tools (not offered for sale or licence)
- [GRACE Trader](https://7s.software/grace): an internal trading terminal, in development.
- [Case Base](https://7s.software/case-base): an internal tool in beta, available on request.
- [Zeppelin](https://7s.software/zeppelin): an internal, local-first tax tool, in development.

## Company
- [Services](https://7s.software/services): software engineering for finance and AI agents: trading systems, market data, fintech software, compliance and tax tools. Prices on request.
